title: Quick Malaysian Almond Stir Fry
description: A fast and flavorful Chinese-inspired stir fry made with crunchy almonds and your choice of protein. Serve over steamed vegetables or rice for a nutritious meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add the sliced almonds and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the wok and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar, soy sauce, and honey until well combined.
Pour the sauce into the wok and stir to combine with the ginger and garlic.
Return the chicken to the wok and stir to coat with the sauce.
Serve the chicken and sauce over steamed vegetables or rice, garnished with chopped scallions.
Enjoy your Quick Malaysian Almond Stir Fry!
